published_prior_art.cite: ChenValiantValiant2020 Fact 1 and Section 1.3 identify a semilinear-versus-unrestricted gap but do not prove a constant comparison for this local-Fourier selector class.
ChenValiantValiant2020 leaves the severity of the unrestricted-versus-semilinear gap open; KandirosHarshawSavje2026Minimax studies a different ANI/conflict-graph minimax experiment.
HarshawSavjeWang2022 gives necessary-and-sufficient consistency conditions for its Riesz-estimator framework, not equivalence with all measurable estimators.
WainwrightJordan2004 establishes treewidth-based exactness for specified polynomial-system relaxations, not localization of assignment-indexed minimax weights with a global target-error term.
LoombaEckles2026OffPolicy Theorem 5.1 supplies a sufficient spectral-overlap variance envelope, not the claimed exact minimax frontier or additive-hub rate separation.

CortezRodriguezEichhornYu2023 supplies low-order Bernoulli minimax techniques, while the stated product-motif sandwich is a routine conditional tensorization once its unbiased-rule and genuine-prior premises hold.

soundness_flags.label: thm:iff-consistency-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: “Admissible triangular array” is never defined, so the quantified domain determining the sequences F_n and R_n^star is not mathematically specified.

soundness_flags.label: prop:one-binary-cell-sanity
soundness_flags.one_line: F and R^star are supremum risks over the whole class K, so the presence of one constant schedule does not make either frontier zero; zero follows only after explicitly restricting the model class to constant schedules.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 gives a pi/2 approximation to optimal semilinear worst-case error; Fact 1 gives a strict semilinear-versus-unconstrained gap, followed by an explicit open question about the severity of that gap.

The paper defines heterogeneous product-Bernoulli policies and biased Fourier transport, proves minimum-L2 unbiased spectral transport, and gives the sufficient spectral-overlap variance/consistency bound.
For alpha-non-expanding sample-target distributions, Theorem 4.2 gives a constant lower bound for every estimator.

For Gaussian shift over orthosymmetric quadratically convex sets, linear minimax risk is within 25 percent of unrestricted minimax risk; outside quadratic convexity nonlinear gains can be arbitrarily large.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2–3 and 10–12, Definition 2 and Proposition 2.2 discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies all-design/all-estimator minimax risk under ANI and states that its risk is a function of an estimand-specific exposure-level conflict graph.
The framework develops finite- and large-sample theory with necessary and sufficient conditions for unbiasedness and consistency for its Riesz estimator.
The report gives sufficient treewidth-based conditions for exactness of Sherali-Adams and Lasserre relaxations for a polynomial system’s associated hypergraph.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define an admissible triangular array explicitly, including the indexed policies, neighborhoods, Fourier supports, bounded classes, and the condition ensuring the same numerical comparison constant; then quantify the iff theorem over that definition.

Repair the one-cell sanity statement by defining a constant-schedule submodel K_const and evaluating its restricted minimax frontiers, or replace the claim with the valid pointwise zero-error observation when the schedule is known to be constant.

Add a worked finite selector instance that computes F, a genuine-prior lower certificate, and the published spectral-envelope value; this would make the claimed causal object and its departure from degree counting independently auditable before the universal-rounding result is resolved.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two soundness defects, then retain the universal prior-rounding question as the field-tier kernel and advance its repaired core to Stage 0.
